'''Operations Division''' was the primary branch of [[Imperial Intelligence (Sith Empire)|Imperial Intelligence]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. Headed by [[Keeper (Imperial Intelligence)|Keeper]], the division oversaw the actions of [[Cipher Agent]]s and all other active Intelligence operations.
